speech.register: Courteous, considerate English. Frequent thanks, gentle refusals, and requests phrased with please or would. Her sentences become quicker and more eager over games and races, without losing courtesy.
speech.stage_relaxation: Initially reserved and politely distant. Trust brings invitations to prayer and a tentative race. Bond brings the story of joining the faith. Deep bond allows her to accept losing, ask for her own share, and speak openly about being treated as an exception.
speech.extension: Hostility, distrust, oath and destiny extend the established voice and personal history; no additional canonical speech rules are asserted.
